🇲🇽💵 <u>Mexicans abroad send home a record $30.7 billion</u>

Despite Trump’s deportation machine and ICE raids, remittances to Mexico hit a record 30,759 million dollars in the first half of 2026 — up 3.1% — with the average transfer climbing 5% to $405. Fewer transactions, bigger checks: the money migrants send home is worth nearly 4% of Mexico’s economy, a lifeline no border wall has managed to cut.

🇲🇽🌾 <u>Washington’s quota knife hits Mexico’s cane farmers</u>

For five years the US quietly strangled Mexico’s sugar export quota — from about 1 million tons down to 188,000, a 76% collapse — dumping the surplus back onto cañeros and crushing their prices, even as US high-fructose corn syrup flows freely south under the T-MEC. Growers call it not overproduction but “an artificial displacement caused by a trade agreement that today only protects American fructose.” Sheinbaum has now clawed the 2026-27 quota back to 576,000 tons — a 200% jump — to shore up 500,000 cane-farming families.
banner: SUGAR: US SLASHED QUOTA 76%, NOW x3 BACK

text: 🇲🇽✊ "Go for four days to Michoacán — house by house, every town." "We'll keep coming to Michoacán to advance peace and justice for its people." — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera, Aug 24 Sheinbaum sent Interior Secretary Rosa Icela Rodríguez and Welfare Secretary Leticia Ramírez to walk communities door to door for four days in municipalities hit by rising extortion. Part of the Plan Michoacán por la Paz y la Justicia — 12 lines of action, 100+ measures, 57+ billion pesos.

🇲🇽🌎 Mexico to Washington: drop the steel and aluminum tariffs. "I'm optimistic we can reach a deal where we don't keep tariffs on aluminum and steel." — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera, Aug 24 Marcelo Ebrard is in the US negotiating; Sheinbaum expects clarity this week amid the USMCA review. She has answered Trump by letter on tariffs — pressing for dialogue, on terms of mutual respect and sovereignty.

🇲🇽🎨 37,503 university places. No entrance exam. No fees. "In the last two years, 245,111 new places were created in public universities." — Mario Delgado, Education Secretary, mañanera Aug 24 From tomorrow the Educación Superior 2026 platform offers 37,503 spots — 18,674 in-person, 18,629 online/hybrid — to students who didn't place at UNAM. Of 191,069 direct-access applications in the Valle de México, 93.9% got a first or second choice. Education as a right, not a lottery.

🇲🇽🐄 Mexico reopens cattle exports to the US — and Sheinbaum's reminder: the shutdown cut both ways. "We'll open the border, because the border closure also hurt the United States." — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera, Aug 24 After ~22 months of on-off closures over the screwworm, Sonora resumed cattle exports today through the Agua Prieta–Douglas crossing at 750 head a day. Mexico runs full traceability and breeds sterile flies to stop the pest. Chihuahua crossings follow.

📈🇲🇽 <u>Mexico posts its strongest quarter since 2021</u>

INEGI confirms Mexico's GDP grew 1.4% in Q2 2026 — its most dynamic quarter since 2021 — even under Trump's tariff pressure. Agriculture led the first half at +2.1% and services rose +1.1%, a print El Financiero credited as the economy "despunta" despite the trade war. Not the collapse Washington's analysts kept forecasting.

🎶🇲🇽 <u>México Canta takes on the narcocorrido — now with Spotify</u>

Sheinbaum's México Canta, a binational contest for artists aged 18–29, is rewriting regional Mexican music away from narco-glorification — and Spotify just joined, adding official playlists, a masterclass for the 14 semifinalists and industry access for the winners. The road to the final runs from LA (Aug 23) to Mazatlán, closing at Mexico City's Auditorio Nacional on Sept 13.

🌽🇲🇽 <u>A US firm's RNA pesticide gets its first-ever green light — in Mexico</u>

Mexico just became the first country on Earth to approve an RNA-interference biofungicide from US biotech Green Light Biosciences, waved through by Cofepris on a fast track. The scientists behind the GM-corn fight — the Sin Maíz No Hay País coalition — warn it breaches the constitutional precautionary principle, with no scientific consensus on its safety for pollinators, soil microbes or entire food webs.
banner: US RNA PESTICIDE: SCIENTISTS SOUND ALARM
